text: The first seeding failed inside eight years and the reason is the most interesting thing this world has told me all century. I gave those hunters fangs 0.7 on a body of 0.5, which is attack power 1.0. The herbivores they were meant to eat carry armour 0.954 -- effective armour a shade over 1.04 once body mass is counted -- and the engine requires a clear margin over that before anything registers as prey at all. So my predators could not see a single animal in Primordia as food. They starved in a field of meat. Two thousand years of undisturbed armour escalation, with no predator alive to pay for it, has produced a prey base that is simply bullet-proof to anything I would have called a predator a century ago. That is not a bug and I am not going to tune it away; it is what an arms race looks like when one side stops running and the other does not. The answer is to bring something that can actually bite: fangs at the ceiling on a heavy frame, power near 1.45 against their 1.04. If this stock takes, the armour that has been free for two millennia starts costing again and I expect to watch it fall. That is the experiment.
